pack.name: The Old Laws
pack.summary: The laws example. Cards and things that change the rules of the game for the rest of the run: fields that count as temples, burned land that still yields, cheaper building, spells that hit harder, a new way to win.

tags.meaning: Old rune stones stand in the furrows.

things.name: Pilgrim shrine
things.text: A roofed walk for pilgrims. While it stands, every temple prays for the town, and enough temples win the run.
things.art: A long roofed walk of pale stone with pilgrims kneeling, painterly.

things.name: Rune stones
things.text: Standing stones cut with growth runes. While they stand, the growth rune pays more, and fire wakes the fields.
things.art: A ring of carved standing stones among green furrows, painterly.

things.name: Builders' guild hall
things.text: Masons and carpenters set their rates here. While it stands, building costs less, and Magic can stand in for workers.
things.art: A timber hall with tools hung on the walls and a long table of plans, painterly.

add_rule.name: Prayers at the temples
add_rule.why: {count} temples prayed for the town: +{n} Magic

cards.title: Bless the furrows
cards.pitch: Let me walk the furrows with the censer. From then on the fields are holy ground, as good as any temple.

if_taken.say: The priest walks the furrows. The fields are holy ground.

if_expires.say: The priest says the town has no faith.

cards.art: A priest with a smoking censer walking between rows of wheat, painterly.

cards.title: Open the pilgrim road
cards.pitch: Build a pilgrim walk at the shrine. Every temple will pray for us, and if the town becomes holy enough, the raiders will not dare come.

if_taken.say: The pilgrim walk is roofed. The first pilgrims come.

if_expires.say: The pilgrims go to another town.

cards.art: Pilgrims with staffs on a mountain path toward a shrine, painterly.

cards.title: Burn the stubble
cards.pitch: My grandfather burned the stubble every autumn. The ash feeds the soil. Burn the east fields and they will still give.

if_taken.say: Smoke over the east fields. The miller sells the straw.

if_expires.say: The stubble rots in the furrows.

cards.art: Low flames running across a stubble field at dusk, painterly.

cards.title: Raise the rune stones
cards.pitch: There are old rune stones in the tower cellar. Set them in the furrows and the growth rune will sing in them.

if_taken.say: The stones stand in the furrows, humming.

if_expires.say: The stones stay in the cellar.

cards.art: Workers levering a carved standing stone upright in a field, painterly.

cards.title: Charter the builders' guild
cards.pitch: Give the masons a hall and a charter and they will set fair rates. Your mages can even stand in for a crew.

if_taken.say: The guild hangs its sign in the market.

if_expires.say: The masons grumble about their pay.

cards.art: A guild master pinning a charter to a timber post in a market, painterly.

cards.title: Ordain fire priests
cards.pitch: Ordain three of my acolytes as fire priests. For a while your fire will strike three at once, and their prayers will thin the raiders.

if_taken.say: The acolytes take the red robe.

if_expires.say: The acolytes go back to sweeping the temple.

cards.art: Three acolytes in red robes kneeling before a brazier, painterly.

cards.title: Let the abbot preach
cards.pitch: The abbot says whatever doubles shall double again. Let him preach, and every hearth in the town is a temple.

if_taken.say: The abbot preaches in the burial ground. People listen.

if_expires.say: The abbot preaches against you instead.

cards.art: A wild-haired abbot preaching from a tomb to a crowd, painterly.

cards.title: Write the town charter
cards.pitch: Write the next law into the town charter and it stands for good. I would start with market days and a right to bear arms.

if_taken.say: The charter is read out in the square.

if_expires.say: The clerk files the charter away.

cards.art: A clerk reading a long parchment aloud in a town square, painterly.

wants: A law that outlives the run (the owner decides).
A law that changes the run's length or the raid's season.
